title: Consumer protection - Privacy by design for consumer goods and services - Part 2: Use cases
description: This document provides illustrative use cases, with associated analysis, to assist in understanding the requirements of ISO 31700-1 . The intended audience includes engineers and practitioners who are involved in the development, implementation or operation of digitally-enabled consumer goods and services.

title: Consumer protection - Privacy by design for consumer goods and services - Part 1: High-level requirements
description: This document establishes high-level requirements for privacy by design to protect privacy throughout the lifecycle of a consumer product, including data processed by the consumer. This document does not contain specific requirements for the privacy assurances and commitments that organizations can offer consumers nor does it specify particular methodologies that an organization can adopt to design and-implement privacy controls, nor the technology that can be used to operate such controls.
